verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י בְּהַעֲל֤וֹת יְהוָה֙ אֶת־ אֵ֣לִיָּ֔הוּ בַּֽסְעָרָ֖ה הַשָּׁמָ֑יִם וַיֵּ֧לֶךְ אֵלִיָּ֛הוּ וֶאֱלִישָׁ֖ע מִן־ הַגִּלְגָּֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî bə·ha·‘ă·lō·wṯ Yah·weh ’eṯ- ’ê·lî·yā·hū bas·‘ā·rāh haš·šā·mā·yim way·yê·leḵ ’ê·lî·yā·hū we·’ĕ·lî·šā‘ min- hag·gil·gāl
verses.literal: Shortly before the LORD took Elijah up to heaven in a whirlwind Elijah and Elisha were on their way from Gilgal
verses.literalPt: Quando Jeová estava para tomar a Elias ao céu por um redemoinho, Elias partiu de Gilgal em companhia de Eliseu.

verses.original: וַיֹּאמֶר֩ אֵלִיָּ֨הוּ אֶל־ אֱלִישָׁ֜ע שֵֽׁב־ נָ֣א פֹ֗ה כִּ֤י יְהוָה֙ שְׁלָחַ֣נִי עַד־ בֵּֽית־ אֵ֔ל וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֱלִישָׁ֔ע חַי־ יְהוָ֥ה וְחֵֽי־ נַפְשְׁךָ֖ אִם־ אֶעֶזְבֶ֑ךָּ וַיֵּרְד֖וּ בֵּֽית־ אֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer ’ê·lî·yā·hū ’el- ’ĕ·lî·šā‘ šêḇ- nā p̄ōh kî Yah·weh šə·lā·ḥa·nî ‘aḏ- bêṯ- ’êl way·yō·mer ’ĕ·lî·šā‘ ḥay- Yah·weh wə·ḥê- nap̄·šə·ḵā ’im- ’e·‘ez·ḇe·kā way·yê·rə·ḏū bêṯ- ’êl
verses.literal: and Elijah said to Elisha Please stay here for the LORD has sent me on to Bethel But Elisha replied As surely as the LORD lives and as you yourself live I will not leave you So they went down to Bethel
verses.literalPt: Disse Elias a Eliseu: Fica-te aqui, porque Jeová me enviou para ir até Betel. Respondeu Eliseu: Pela vida de Jeová e pela vida da tua alma, que não te deixarei. Desceram a Betel.

verses.original: וַיֵּצְא֨וּ בְנֵֽי־ הַנְּבִיאִ֥ים אֲשֶׁר־ בֵּֽית־ אֵל֮ אֶל־ אֱלִישָׁע֒ וַיֹּאמְר֣וּ אֵלָ֔יו הֲיָדַ֕עְתָּ כִּ֣י הַיּ֗וֹם יְהוָ֛ה לֹקֵ֥חַ אֶת־ אֲדֹנֶ֖יךָ מֵעַ֣ל רֹאשֶׁ֑ךָ וַיֹּ֛אמֶר גַּם־ אֲנִ֥י יָדַ֖עְתִּי הֶחֱשֽׁוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·ṣə·’ū ḇə·nê- han·nə·ḇî·’îm ’ă·šer- bêṯ- ’êl ’el- ’ĕ·lî·šā‘ way·yō·mə·rū ’ê·lāw hă·yā·ḏa‘·tā kî hay·yō·wm Yah·weh lō·qê·aḥ ’eṯ- ’ă·ḏō·ne·ḵā mê·‘al rō·še·ḵā way·yō·mer gam- ’ă·nî yā·ḏa‘·tî he·ḥĕ·šū
verses.literal: Then the sons of the prophets at Bethel came out to Elisha and said . . . Do you know that the LORD will take your master away from you today Yes I know he replied Do not speak of it
verses.literalPt: Os filhos dos profetas que estavam em Betel saíram ao encontro de Eliseu, e disseram-lhe: Sabes que Jeová há de tirar, hoje, o teu amo de sobre a tua cabeça? Respondeu ele: Também eu o sei; calai-vos.

verses.original: וַיֹּאמֶר֩ ל֨וֹ אֵלִיָּ֜הוּ אֱלִישָׁ֣ע׀ שֵֽׁב־ נָ֣א פֹ֗ה כִּ֤י יְהוָה֙ שְׁלָחַ֣נִי יְרִיח֔וֹ וַיֹּ֕אמֶר חַי־ יְהוָ֥ה וְחֵֽי־ נַפְשְׁךָ֖ אִם־ אֶעֶזְבֶ֑ךָּ וַיָּבֹ֖אוּ יְרִיחֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer lōw ’ê·lî·yā·hū ’ĕ·lî·šā‘ šêḇ- nā p̄ōh kî Yah·weh šə·lā·ḥa·nî yə·rî·ḥōw way·yō·mer ḥay- Yah·weh wə·ḥê- nap̄·šə·ḵā ’im- ’e·‘ez·ḇe·kā way·yā·ḇō·’ū yə·rî·ḥōw
verses.literal: And Elijah said to Elisha Please stay here for the LORD has sent me on to Jericho But Elisha replied As surely as the LORD lives and as you yourself live I will not leave you So they went to Jericho
verses.literalPt: Disse Elias a Eliseu: Fica-te aqui, porque Jeová me enviou a Jericó. Respondeu Eliseu: Pela vida de Jeová e pela vida da tua alma, que não te deixarei. Assim, foram a Jericó.

verses.original: וַיִּגְּשׁ֨וּ בְנֵֽי־ הַנְּבִיאִ֥ים אֲשֶׁר־ בִּֽירִיחוֹ֮ אֶל־ אֱלִישָׁע֒ וַיֹּאמְר֣וּ אֵלָ֔יו הֲיָדַ֕עְתָּ כִּ֣י הַיּ֗וֹם יְהוָ֛ה לֹקֵ֥חַ אֶת־ אֲדֹנֶ֖יךָ מֵעַ֣ל רֹאשֶׁ֑ךָ וַיֹּ֛אמֶר גַּם־ אֲנִ֥י יָדַ֖עְתִּי הֶחֱשֽׁוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yig·gə·šū ḇə·nê- han·nə·ḇî·’îm ’ă·šer- bî·rî·ḥōw ’el- ’ĕ·lî·šā‘ way·yō·mə·rū ’ê·lāw hă·yā·ḏa‘·tā kî hay·yō·wm Yah·weh lō·qê·aḥ ’eṯ- ’ă·ḏō·ne·ḵā mê·‘al rō·še·ḵā way·yō·mer gam- ’ă·nî yā·ḏa‘·tî he·ḥĕ·šū
verses.literal: Then the sons of the prophets at Jericho came up to Elisha and said . . . Do you know that the LORD will take your master away from you today Yes I know he replied Do not speak of it
verses.literalPt: Então, os filhos dos profetas que estavam em Jericó se chegaram a Eliseu e lhe disseram: Sabes que Jeová há de tirar, hoje, o teu amo de sobre a tua cabeça? Respondeu ele: Também eu o sei; calai-vos.

verses.original: וַיֹּאמֶר֩ ל֨וֹ אֵלִיָּ֜הוּ שֵֽׁב־ נָ֣א פֹ֗ה כִּ֤י יְהוָה֙ שְׁלָחַ֣נִי הַיַּרְדֵּ֔נָה וַיֹּ֕אמֶר חַי־ יְהוָ֥ה וְחֵֽי־ נַפְשְׁךָ֖ אִם־ אֶעֶזְבֶ֑ךָּ וַיֵּלְכ֖וּ שְׁנֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer lōw ’ê·lî·yā·hū šêḇ- nā p̄ōh kî Yah·weh šə·lā·ḥa·nî hay·yar·dê·nāh way·yō·mer ḥay- Yah·weh wə·ḥê- nap̄·šə·ḵā ’im- ’e·‘ez·ḇe·kā way·yê·lə·ḵū šə·nê·hem
verses.literal: And Elijah said to Elisha Please stay here for the LORD has sent me on to the Jordan But Elisha replied As surely as the LORD lives and as you yourself live I will not leave you So the two of them went on
verses.literalPt: Elias disse-lhe: Fica-te aqui, porque Jeová me enviou ao Jordão. Respondeu Eliseu: Pela vida de Jeová e pela vida da tua alma, que não te deixarei. Foram, pois, ambos juntos.

verses.original: וַחֲמִשִּׁ֨ים אִ֜ישׁ מִבְּנֵ֤י הַנְּבִיאִים֙ הָֽלְכ֔וּ וַיַּעַמְד֥וּ מִנֶּ֖גֶד מֵרָח֑וֹק וּשְׁנֵיהֶ֖ם עָמְד֥וּ עַל־ הַיַּרְדֵּֽן׃
verses.transliteration: wa·ḥă·miš·šîm ’îš mib·bə·nê han·nə·ḇî·’îm hā·lə·ḵū way·ya·‘am·ḏū min·ne·ḡeḏ mê·rā·ḥō·wq ū·šə·nê·hem ‘ā·mə·ḏū ‘al- hay·yar·dên
verses.literal: Then a company of fifty of the sons of the prophets went and stood at a distance facing Elijah and Elisha as the two of them stood by the Jordan
verses.literalPt: Foram cinquenta homens dos filhos dos profetas e pararam defronte deles, de longe; eles ambos pararam junto ao Jordão.

verses.original: וַיִּקַּח֩ אֵלִיָּ֨הוּ אֶת־ אַדַּרְתּ֤וֹ וַיִּגְלֹם֙ וַיַּכֶּ֣ה אֶת־ הַמַּ֔יִם וַיֵּחָצ֖וּ הֵ֣נָּה וָהֵ֑נָּה וַיַּעַבְר֥וּ שְׁנֵיהֶ֖ם בֶּחָרָבָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·qaḥ ’ê·lî·yā·hū ’eṯ- ’ad·dar·tōw way·yiḡ·lōm way·yak·keh ’eṯ- ham·ma·yim way·yê·ḥā·ṣū hên·nāh wā·hên·nāh way·ya·‘aḇ·rū šə·nê·hem be·ḥā·rā·ḇāh
verses.literal: And Elijah took his cloak rolled it up and struck the waters which parted to the right and to the left so that the two of them crossed over on dry ground
verses.literalPt: Elias tomou o seu manto e, dobrando-o, feriu as águas, as quais se dividiram para as duas bandas, de modo que ambos passaram a pé enxuto.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֣י כְעָבְרָ֗ם וְאֵ֨לִיָּ֜הוּ אָמַ֤ר אֶל־ אֱלִישָׁע֙ שְׁאַל֙ מָ֣ה אֶֽעֱשֶׂה־ לָּ֔ךְ בְּטֶ֖רֶם אֶלָּקַ֣ח מֵעִמָּ֑ךְ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֱלִישָׁ֔ע וִֽיהִי־ נָ֛א פִּֽי־ שְׁנַ֥יִם בְּרוּחֲךָ֖ אֵלָֽי׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ḵə·‘ā·ḇə·rām wə·’ê·lî·yā·hū ’ā·mar ’el- ’ĕ·lî·šā‘ šə·’al māh ’e·‘ĕ·śeh- lāḵ bə·ṭe·rem ’el·lā·qaḥ mê·‘im·māḵ way·yō·mer ’ĕ·lî·šā‘ wî·hî- nā pî- šə·na·yim bə·rū·ḥă·ḵā ’ê·lāy
verses.literal: After they had crossed over Elijah said to Elisha Tell me what can I do for you before I am taken away from you Please let me inherit a double portion of your spirit Elisha replied
verses.literalPt: Depois de terem passado, disse Elias a Eliseu: Pede o que te hei de fazer, antes que seja de ti arrebatado. Respondeu Eliseu: Peço-te que haja sobre mim uma dobrada porção do teu espírito.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֖אמֶר הִקְשִׁ֣יתָ לִשְׁא֑וֹל אִם־ תִּרְאֶ֨ה אֹתִ֜י לֻקָּ֤ח מֵֽאִתָּךְ֙ יְהִֽי־ לְךָ֣ כֵ֔ן וְאִם־ אַ֖יִן לֹ֥א יִהְיֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer hiq·šî·ṯā liš·’ō·wl ’im- tir·’eh ’ō·ṯî luq·qāḥ mê·’it·tāḵ yə·hî- lə·ḵā ḵên wə·’im- ’a·yin lō yih·yeh
verses.literal: You have requested a difficult thing said Elijah Nevertheless, if you see me as I am taken from you it will be yours . . . But if not then it will not be so
verses.literalPt: Tornou-lhe Elias: Difícil coisa pediste. Todavia, se me vires quando de ti for arrebatado, assim se te fará; porém, do contrário, não se te fará.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י הֵ֣מָּה הֹלְכִ֤ים הָלוֹךְ֙ וְדַבֵּ֔ר וְהִנֵּ֤ה רֶֽכֶב־ אֵשׁ֙ וְס֣וּסֵי אֵ֔שׁ וַיַּפְרִ֖דוּ בֵּ֣ין שְׁנֵיהֶ֑ם וַיַּ֙עַל֙ אֵ֣לִיָּ֔הוּ בַּֽסְעָרָ֖ה הַשָּׁמָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî hêm·māh hō·lə·ḵîm hā·lō·wḵ wə·ḏab·bêr wə·hin·nêh re·ḵeḇ- ’êš wə·sū·sê ’êš way·yap̄·ri·ḏū bên šə·nê·hem way·ya·‘al ’ê·lî·yā·hū bas·sə·‘ā·rāh haš·šā·mā·yim
verses.literal: As they were walking along . . . and talking together suddenly a chariot of fire with horses of fire appeared and separated . . . the two of them and Elijah went up into heaven in a whirlwind
verses.literalPt: Caminhando eles ainda e conversando, eis que apareceu um carro de fogo e cavalos de fogo, os quais os separaram um do outro; Elias subiu ao céu por um redemoinho.

verses.original: וֶאֱלִישָׁ֣ע רֹאֶ֗ה וְה֤וּא מְצַעֵק֙ אָבִ֣י׀ אָבִ֗י רֶ֤כֶב יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וּפָ֣רָשָׁ֔יו וְלֹ֥א רָאָ֖הוּ ע֑וֹד וַֽיַּחֲזֵק֙ בִּבְגָדָ֔יו וַיִּקְרָעֵ֖ם לִשְׁנַ֥יִם קְרָעִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: we·’ĕ·lî·šā‘ rō·’eh wə·hū mə·ṣa·‘êq ’ā·ḇî ’ā·ḇî re·ḵeḇ yiś·rā·’êl ū·p̄ā·rā·šāw wə·lō rā·’ā·hū ‘ō·wḏ way·ya·ḥă·zêq biḇ·ḡā·ḏāw way·yiq·rā·‘êm liš·na·yim qə·rā·‘îm
verses.literal: As Elisha watched he cried out My father my father the chariots and horsemen of Israel And he saw Elijah no more So taking hold of his own clothes he tore them in two . . .
verses.literalPt: Eliseu o viu e clamou: Meu pai, meu pai! Carros de Israel e os seus cavaleiros! Não o viu mais; pegou nos seus vestidos e rasgou-os em duas partes.

verses.original: וַיָּ֙רֶם֙ אֶת־ אַדֶּ֣רֶת אֵלִיָּ֔הוּ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נָפְלָ֖ה מֵעָלָ֑יו וַיָּ֥שָׁב וַֽיַּעֲמֹ֖ד עַל־ שְׂפַ֥ת הַיַּרְדֵּֽן׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·rem ’eṯ- ’ad·de·reṯ ’ê·lî·yā·hū ’ă·šer nā·p̄ə·lāh mê·‘ā·lāw way·yā·šāḇ way·ya·‘ă·mōḏ ‘al- śə·p̄aṯ hay·yar·dên
verses.literal: Elisha also picked up the cloak that had fallen from Elijah and he went back and stood on the bank of the Jordan
verses.literalPt: Também levantou o manto de Elias, que este deixara cair, e, voltando, pôs-se à borda do Jordão.

verses.original: וַיִּקַּח֩ אֶת־ אַדֶּ֨רֶת אֵלִיָּ֜הוּ אֲשֶׁר־ נָפְלָ֤ה מֵֽעָלָיו֙ וַיַּכֶּ֣ה אֶת־ הַמַּ֔יִם וַיֹּאמַ֕ר אַיֵּ֕ה יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֣י אֵלִיָּ֑הוּ אַף־ ה֣וּא׀ וַיַּכֶּ֣ה אֶת־ הַמַּ֗יִם וַיֵּֽחָצוּ֙ הֵ֣נָּה וָהֵ֔נָּה וַֽיַּעֲבֹ֖ר אֱלִישָֽׁע׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·qaḥ ’eṯ- ’ad·de·reṯ ’ê·lî·yā·hū ’ă·šer- nā·p̄ə·lāh mê·‘ā·lāw way·yak·keh ’eṯ- ham·ma·yim way·yō·mar ’ay·yêh Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê ’ê·lî·yā·hū ’ap̄- hū way·yak·keh ’eṯ- ham·ma·yim way·yê·ḥā·ṣū hên·nāh wā·hên·nāh way·ya·‘ă·ḇōr ’ĕ·lî·šā‘
verses.literal: Then he took the cloak of Elijah that had fallen from him and struck the waters Where now is the LORD the God of Elijah . . . he asked And when he had struck the waters they parted to the right and to the left and Elisha crossed over
verses.literalPt: Tomou o manto que Elias deixara cair, feriu as águas e disse: Onde está Jeová, Deus de Elias? Quando ele ferira as águas, elas se dividiram para as duas bandas, e Eliseu passou.

verses.original: וַיִּרְאֻ֨הוּ בְנֵֽי־ הַנְּבִיאִ֤ים אֲשֶׁר־ בִּֽירִיחוֹ֙ מִנֶּ֔גֶד וַיֹּ֣אמְר֔וּ נָ֛חָה ר֥וּחַ אֵלִיָּ֖הוּ עַל־ אֱלִישָׁ֑ע וַיָּבֹ֙אוּ֙ לִקְרָאת֔וֹ וַיִּשְׁתַּחֲווּ־ ל֖וֹ אָֽרְצָה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yir·’u·hū ḇə·nê- han·nə·ḇî·’îm ’ă·šer- bî·rî·ḥōw min·ne·ḡeḏ way·yō·mə·rū nā·ḥāh rū·aḥ ’ê·lî·yā·hū ‘al- ’ĕ·lî·šā‘ way·yā·ḇō·’ū liq·rā·ṯōw way·yiš·ta·ḥă·wū- lōw ’ā·rə·ṣāh
verses.literal: When the sons of the prophets who were watching him from Jericho saw what had happened they said The spirit of Elijah rests on Elisha And they went to meet him and bowed down to the ground before him
verses.literalPt: Vendo-o os filhos dos profetas que estavam defronte, em Jericó, disseram: O espírito de Elias repousa sobre Eliseu. Vieram-lhe ao encontro e prostraram-se com o rosto em terra, diante dele.

verses.original: וַיֹּאמְר֣וּ אֵלָ֡יו הִנֵּה־ נָ֣א יֵֽשׁ־ אֶת־ עֲבָדֶיךָ֩ חֲמִשִּׁ֨ים אֲנָשִׁ֜ים בְּנֵֽי־ חַ֗יִל יֵ֣לְכוּ נָא֮ וִיבַקְשׁ֣וּ אֶת־ אֲדֹנֶיךָ֒ פֶּן־ נְשָׂאוֹ֙ ר֣וּחַ יְהוָ֔ה וַיַּשְׁלִכֵ֙הוּ֙ בְּאַחַ֣ד הֶהָרִ֔ים א֖וֹ בְּאַחַ֣ת הַגְּיָאוֹת וַיֹּ֖אמֶר לֹ֥א תִשְׁלָֽחוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mə·rū ’ê·lāw hin·nêh- nā yêš- ’eṯ- ‘ă·ḇā·ḏe·ḵā ḥă·miš·šîm ’ă·nā·šîm bə·nê- ḥa·yil yê·lə·ḵū nā wî·ḇaq·šū ’eṯ- ’ă·ḏō·ne·ḵā pen- nə·śā·’ōw rū·aḥ Yah·weh way·yaš·li·ḵê·hū bə·’a·ḥaḏ he·hā·rîm ’ōw bə·’a·ḥaṯ hag·gə·yå̄·ʾōṯ way·yō·mer lō ṯiš·lā·ḥū
verses.literal: Look now they said to Elisha we your servants have fifty valiant men . . . Please let them go and search for your master Perhaps the Spirit of the LORD has taken him up and put him on one of the mountains or in one of the valleys Do not send them Elisha replied
verses.literalPt: Disseram-lhe: Eis que, agora, entre os teus servos há cinquenta homens fortes. Deixa-os ir, te pedimos, em procura do teu amo; não suceda que o Espírito de Jeová o tenha arrebatado e atirado com ele para algum monte ou para algum vale. Eliseu respondeu: Não envieis.

verses.original: וַיִּפְצְרוּ־ ב֥וֹ עַד־ בֹּ֖שׁ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר שְׁלָ֑חוּ וַֽיִּשְׁלְחוּ֙ חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים אִ֔ישׁ וַיְבַקְשׁ֥וּ שְׁלֹשָֽׁה־ יָמִ֖ים וְלֹ֥א מְצָאֻֽהוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yip̄·ṣə·rū- ḇōw ‘aḏ- bōš way·yō·mer šə·lā·ḥū way·yiš·lə·ḥū ḥă·miš·šîm ’îš way·ḇaq·šū šə·lō·šāh- yā·mîm wə·lō mə·ṣā·’u·hū
verses.literal: But when they pressed him to the point of embarrassment he said Send them And they sent fifty men who searched for three days but did not find Elijah
verses.literalPt: Quando instaram com ele, até que se envergonhou, ele disse: Enviai. Enviaram cinquenta homens, que o buscaram por três dias; porém não o acharam.

verses.original: וַיָּשֻׁ֣בוּ אֵלָ֔יו וְה֖וּא יֹשֵׁ֣ב בִּירִיח֑וֹ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֲלֵהֶ֔ם הֲלֽוֹא־ אָמַ֥רְתִּי אֲלֵיכֶ֖ם אַל־ תֵּלֵֽכוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·šu·ḇū ’ê·lāw wə·hū yō·šêḇ bî·rî·ḥōw way·yō·mer ’ă·lê·hem hă·lō·w- ’ā·mar·tî ’ă·lê·ḵem ’al- tê·lê·ḵū
verses.literal: When they returned to Elisha who was staying in Jericho he said to them Didn’t I tell you not to go
verses.literalPt: Voltaram para ele, que os esperava em Jericó; e ele lhes disse: Não vos disse eu: Não vades?

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמְר֜וּ אַנְשֵׁ֤י הָעִיר֙ אֶל־ אֱלִישָׁ֔ע הִנֵּה־ נָ֞א מוֹשַׁ֤ב הָעִיר֙ ט֔וֹב כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר אֲדֹנִ֖י רֹאֶ֑ה וְהַמַּ֥יִם רָעִ֖ים וְהָאָ֥רֶץ מְשַׁכָּֽלֶת׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mə·rū ’an·šê hā·‘îr ’el- ’ĕ·lî·šā‘ hin·nêh- nā mō·wō·šaḇ hā·‘îr ṭō·wḇ ka·’ă·šer ’ă·ḏō·nî rō·’eh wə·ham·ma·yim rā·‘îm wə·hā·’ā·reṣ mə·šak·kā·leṯ
verses.literal: Then the men of the city said to Elisha Please note our lord that the city’s location is good as you can see But the water is bad and the land is unfruitful
verses.literalPt: Os habitantes da cidade disseram a Eliseu: Eis que a situação desta cidade é agradável, como vê o meu senhor; mas as águas são péssimas, e a terra é estéril.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֗אמֶר קְחוּ־ לִי֙ צְלֹחִ֣ית חֲדָשָׁ֔ה וְשִׂ֥ימוּ שָׁ֖ם מֶ֑לַח וַיִּקְח֖וּ אֵלָֽיו׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer qə·ḥū- lî ṣə·lō·ḥîṯ ḥă·ḏā·šāh wə·śî·mū šām me·laḥ way·yiq·ḥū ’ê·lāw
verses.literal: Bring me a new bowl he replied and put some salt in it So they brought it to him
verses.literalPt: Ele disse: Trazei-me um vaso novo e ponde nele sal. Eles lho trouxeram.

verses.original: וַיֵּצֵא֙ אֶל־ מוֹצָ֣א הַמַּ֔יִם וַיַּשְׁלֶךְ־ שָׁ֖ם מֶ֑לַח וַיֹּ֜אמֶר כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֣ר יְהוָ֗ה רִפִּ֙אתִי֙ לַמַּ֣יִם הָאֵ֔לֶּה לֹֽא־ יִהְיֶ֥ה מִשָּׁ֛ם ע֖וֹד מָ֥וֶת וּמְשַׁכָּֽלֶת׃
verses.transliteration: way·yê·ṣê ’el- mō·w·ṣā ham·ma·yim way·yaš·leḵ- šām me·laḥ way·yō·mer kōh- ’ā·mar Yah·weh rip·pi·ṯî lam·ma·yim hā·’êl·leh lō- yih·yeh miš·šām ‘ō·wḏ mā·weṯ ū·mə·šak·kā·leṯ
verses.literal: and Elisha went out to the spring . . . cast the salt into it and said This is what the LORD says I have healed this water No longer will it cause . . . death or unfruitfulness
verses.literalPt: Então, saiu à fonte das águas, e deitou nela sal, e disse: Assim diz Jeová: Curei estas águas; elas não serão mais a causa de morte nem de esterilidade.

verses.original: וַיֵּרָפ֣וּ הַמַּ֔יִם עַ֖ד הַיּ֣וֹם הַזֶּ֑ה כִּדְבַ֥ר אֱלִישָׁ֖ע אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבֵּֽר׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yê·rā·p̄ū ham·ma·yim ‘aḏ hay·yō·wm haz·zeh kiḏ·ḇar ’ĕ·lî·šā‘ ’ă·šer dib·bêr
verses.literal: And the waters there have been healthy to this day according to the word spoken by Elisha
verses.literalPt: Ficaram as águas sadias até o dia de hoje, conforme a palavra que Eliseu proferiu.

verses.original: וַיַּ֥עַל מִשָּׁ֖ם בֵּֽית־ אֵ֑ל וְה֣וּא׀ עֹלֶ֣ה בַדֶּ֗רֶךְ וּנְעָרִ֤ים קְטַנִּים֙ יָצְא֣וּ מִן־ הָעִ֔יר וַיִּתְקַלְּסוּ־ בוֹ֙ וַיֹּ֣אמְרוּ ל֔וֹ עֲלֵ֥ה קֵרֵ֖חַ עֲלֵ֥ה קֵרֵֽחַ׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘al miš·šām bêṯ- ’êl wə·hū ‘ō·leh ḇad·de·reḵ ū·nə·‘ā·rîm qə·ṭan·nîm yā·ṣə·’ū min- hā·‘îr way·yiṯ·qal·lə·sū- ḇōw way·yō·mə·rū lōw ‘ă·lêh qê·rê·aḥ ‘ă·lêh qê·rê·aḥ
verses.literal: From there Elisha went up to Bethel and as he was walking up the road a group of boys . . . came out of the city and jeered at him chanting Go up you baldhead Go up you baldhead
verses.literalPt: Dali, subiu a Betel; enquanto ele ia subindo pelo caminho, saíram da cidade uns rapazes, zombaram dele e lhe disseram: Sobe, calvo; sobe, calvo.

verses.original: וַיִּ֤פֶן אַֽחֲרָיו֙ וַיִּרְאֵ֔ם וַֽיְקַלְלֵ֖ם בְּשֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֑ה וַתֵּצֶ֨אנָה שְׁתַּ֤יִם דֻּבִּים֙ מִן־ הַיַּ֔עַר וַתְּבַקַּ֣עְנָה מֵהֶ֔ם אַרְבָּעִ֥ים וּשְׁנֵ֖י יְלָדִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yi·p̄en ’a·ḥă·rāw way·yir·’êm way·qal·lêm bə·šêm Yah·weh wat·tê·ṣe·nāh šə·ta·yim dub·bîm min- hay·ya·‘ar wat·tə·ḇaq·qa‘·nāh mê·hem ’ar·bā·‘îm ū·šə·nê yə·lā·ḏîm
verses.literal: Then he turned around looked at them and called down a curse on them in the name of the LORD Suddenly two female bears came out of the woods and mauled . . . forty-two . . . of the boys
verses.literalPt: Ele olhou para trás, viu-os e amaldiçoou-os em nome de Jeová. Saíram do bosque duas ursas e despedaçaram deles quarenta e dois.

verses.original: וַיֵּ֥לֶךְ מִשָּׁ֖ם אֶל־ הַ֣ר הַכַּרְמֶ֑ל וּמִשָּׁ֖ם שָׁ֥ב שֹׁמְרֽוֹן׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·yê·leḵ miš·šām ’el- har hak·kar·mel ū·miš·šām šāḇ šō·mə·rō·wn
verses.literal: And Elisha went on to Mount Carmel and from there he returned to Samaria
verses.literalPt: Dali, foi para o monte Carmelo e, de lá, voltou para Samaria.
